name: Legislation of Georgia (laws, from Matsne)
label: Georgia: laws
record_note: every main document in Matsne's "law" group (Constitution, constitutional and organic laws, codes, laws, autonomous-republic laws), in force or expired; sub-legislative acts not included; changes published but in force after the build day are on the future branch

dates.commit: in-force (from the amending act's own in-force article)

scope.when_absent: no scope note extracted for Georgia; transitional provisions are in the amending act at the Source link

default_reach.rule: no retroactive effect unless the act says so
default_reach.meaning: a normative act has no retroactive force unless it expressly provides so; a law that establishes or aggravates liability never has retroactive force
default_reach.authority: Constitution of Georgia, art. 31(5) (2017 text); Law of Georgia on Normative Acts, art. 24

citation.note: forms "მუხლი N", "მე-N მუხლი", "N-ე მუხლი"; articles with a superscript number (file 12-1.md = article 12¹) are not matched by the file rule; the first article is written "პირველი მუხლი" and lists ("120-ე და 121-ე მუხლები") match only their last number; citations are within the same law
